name: Ig2_ChainedCylinder_ChainedCylinder_ScGeom6D
description: Create/update a ScGeom instance representing connexion between chained cylinders<ChainedCylinder>.

attributes.name: halfLengthContacts
attributes.description: If True, Cylinders nodes interact like spheres of radius 0.5*length, else one node has size length while the other has size 0. The difference is mainly the locus of rotation definition.

attributes.name: interactionDetectionFactor
attributes.description: Enlarge both radii by this factor (if >1), to permit creation of distant interactions.
